judgeScores.name: Priyanka
judgeScores.comments: decent - the very last labels on process telemetry and kernel & posich arch were not visible, other than that, it was all right, average, just pass

observations: Deep native telemetry with microsecond-level C-call latency profiling table, one-click formatted ASCII report export to clipboard, and per-core CPU frequency scaling/governor telemetry. However, UI card container was clamped to 160px causing bottom detail labels to clip, and experienced a 42k-token thinking loop.

judgeScores.name: Priyanka
judgeScores.comments: nice, it even seems more efficient than 3.8 flash in terms of tokens used, also copying the values to the clipboard was cute
